title: Sunder Nursery Delhi -History, Timings, Attractions & Travel Guide
content:
Sunder Nursery - Delhi, 

Sunder Nursery in Delhi is a stunning blend of heritage and nature, often called the “Central Park of Delhi”. Spread across 90 acres, this park features Mughal-era monuments, beautifully landscaped gardens, water bodies, and a wide variety of plants and birds. Located next to Humayun’s Tomb, it is a UNESCO World Heritage site buffer zone and one of the most scenic spots in the city.

History of Sunder Nursery:

The origins of Sunder Nursery date back to the 16th century, when it was established as a Mughal-era garden. It houses several heritage monuments like the Sunder Burj, Lakkarwala Burj, and Sunderwala Mahal. Over time, it became a nursery for exotic plants during the British era. In recent years, it has been redeveloped by the Aga Khan Trust for Culture, transforming it into a cultural and ecological space that blends Delhi’s heritage with modern landscaping.

Major Attractions at Sunder Nursery:

  • Heritage Monuments -Tombs and Mughal-era structures like Sunder Burj and Lakkarwala Burj.
  • Botanical Collections - Over 300 species of trees and plants including rare ones.
  • Biodiversity Zones - haven for migratory birds, butterflies, and bees.
  • Water Bodies & Lakes - Beautiful ponds and lakes that enhance the landscape.
  • Amphitheatre & Open Spaces - Used for cultural events, exhibitions, and performances.
  • Picnic & Photography Spots - Perfect for family outings and nature photography.

Visitor Information:

  • Location: Opposite Humayun’s Tomb, Mathura Road, New Delhi.
  • Timings: 7:00 AM – 6:00 PM (all days).
  • Entry Fee: ₹50 (Indians), ₹200 (Foreigners), Free for children below 12 years.
  • Parking Information: Paid parking available near the main entrance.

How to Reach Sunder Nursery:

  • By Metro: Nearest metro station is JLN Stadium (Violet Line), around 2 km away.
  • By Bus/Auto: Easily reachable by local buses and auto-rickshaws.
  • By Car: Located on Mathura Road, with parking facilities available at the entrance.

Best Time to Visit: Sunder Nursery can be visited throughout the year, but October to March is the most pleasant season. During winter and early spring, the garden is full of blooming flowers, making it the best time for photography, picnics, and walks.

Nearby Places to Visit:

  • Humayun’s Tomb (500 m),
  • Nizamuddin Dargah (1.5 km),
  • India Gate (3 km),
  • Lodhi Gardens (4 km),

Travel Tips:

  • Visit early morning or evening for a peaceful experience.
  • Carry a mat and snacks if planning a family picnic.
  • Don’t miss exploring the heritage monuments within the park.
  • Wear comfortable shoes for walking and exploring the gardens.
excerpt: Sunder Nursery in Delhi is more than just a garden—it’s a cultural, ecological, and historical landmark. With its Mughal monuments, colorful flowers, lakes, and serene atmosphere, it is a must-visit for families, nature lovers, and history buffs. A perfect destination for a peaceful escape in the heart of Delhi.
author: Aniruddh
